description: The direction of every metric in measures/metrics.yaml, frozen for review. The old registry stated no direction; these are derived (owner to confirm): an explicit override first, then the name rule in tests/test_metric_directions.py (unit error_rate or a lower-is-better word in the id -> lower; a higher-is-better word -> higher; otherwise none). A change to any direction must change this file in the same commit.
